title: Masser Modpack
description: A Minecraft modpack for the Masser server with custom races, enhanced graphics, and performance optimizations.
body:
# Masser Official Server Modpack

## What This Project Does

This is the **official modpack for the Masser Minecraft server**. It automatically installs and configures all required mods to play on our server, including:

- **Custom race system** with unique abilities and perks
- **Performance optimizations** (Sodium, Fabric API)
- **Enhanced graphics** (Iris shaders with Complementary Unbound)
- **Quality of life improvements** (Xaero's Minimap, Distant Horizons, Logical Zoom)
- **Server-specific features** that only work on the Masser server

## Why You Should Download This

**If you want to play on the Masser server**, this modpack is **required** for the full experience. Without it, you'll miss:
- The race selection system and custom abilities
- Visual enhancements designed for our server
- Performance optimizations for multiplayer gameplay
- Pre-configured settings that work best with our server

**If you don't plan to play on Masser server**, this modpack is not recommended as many features are server-specific.

## Critical Information Before Downloading

- **Server Requirement**: This modpack is designed exclusively for `185.83.152.80:25581` (Masser server)
- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.8 with Fabric Loader 0.17.2
- **RAM Requirement**: 6-8GB allocated to Minecraft recommended
- **Custom Content**: Includes the Masser mod which adds races and server-specific features
- **Auto-Configuration**: The Masser server will be automatically added to your multiplayer list

## Installation

1. Download this modpack (.mrpack file)
2. Import into Modrinth App
3. Launch and the server will be pre-configured
4. Join the Masser server and select your race

## Included Mods

**Core Functionality:**
- Masser Core Mod (custom races and server features)
- Fabric API (mod compatibility)

**Performance:**
- Sodium (rendering optimization)
- Distant Horizons (extended render distance)

**Graphics:**
- Iris Shaders (shader support)
- Complementary Unbound Shaders (pre-installed)

**Quality of Life:**
- Xaero's Minimap (navigation)
- Logical Zoom (zoom functionality)

## Support

For technical issues or questions about the Masser server:
- Server IP: `185.83.152.80:25581`

---

**Note**: This modpack contains both open-source mods from the community and custom content created specifically for the Masser server. Individual mods retain their original licenses.
